items.text: A fact-checking service has rated the claim that the sea is rising as mostly false, after finding that it only rises and falls twice a day.
A man has been told by a woman on a date that he seems nice, but his great-great-grandfather owned a smaller continent.
The Ministry of Records regrets to advise that the Great Flood of the 3100s was a clerical matter, and that anyone still underwater should lodge a form.
A grandfather has been told by his great-grandchildren that his stories about walking to school are a bit much, since nobody has walked anywhere in two hundred years.
The Department of Lunch has confirmed that sandwiches must now be approved in triplicate, and the approval form is available in the cafeteria, which is closed pending approval.
Scientists have confirmed the universe is 13.8 billion years old, and the museum says its 'Children Under Five' ticket still applies.
